note: Signer of every published OpenLumen release. Read on 2026-09-05 from the v0.7.1 APK on the releases page with apksigner verify --print-certs, not from the local keystore, because the point of the pin is to catch a build signed with the wrong key and a local keystore cannot answer that question about itself. It matches ~/.android/openlumen-release/openlumen-release.jks, alias openlumen, CN=OpenLumen. Change this only when the signing key is deliberately rotated, and expect every installed copy to refuse the update when it happens.
